description: This file is a shell script for testing Git operations related to applying patches that involve various changes such as renaming, changing types (file, directory, symlink, binary), and reverting changes. It uses test-lib.sh for testing utilities and contains multiple test cases to verify correct behavior of 'git apply' with different scenarios involving file changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function for defining a test case expecting success, executing commands, and checking results.

methods.name: test_debug
methods.description: A function for outputting debug information, such as the contents of patches.
